dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Keep your spirits up! Good things will eventually come around!

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: The Shogunate and the rebels signed a peace treaty! That means that there's a chance that the mines will return to normal.

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: Though the ceasefire is a good thing, I can't help but think of the victims in Higi Village...

dialogues.speaker: Kaji
dialogues.text: I wonder how long it'll take for that place to recover...
